question: What existing evidence distinguishes a physical-entry d stroke, a meaning-bearing d prefix, or a written component separated from an a-initial remainder?
scope: Existing reports, raw proposals and followup navigation only. No new transcription/profile query, image, census, source encoding or word meaning. Native strings below are retained formal observations, not translations or proven morphemes.
main_decision: Do not select another initial-d correlation or shortened-context counterpart census. The exact sequence1149→1150 already establishes the relevant positional constraint and stops the immediate counterpart route. The evidence leaves distinct explanations open without supplying a new discriminating hand test.

specific_existing_entry_evidence.positive: Bare ain/aiin/aiiin avoid starts even on physical continuation lines of source-bounded multiline paragraphs. The observation is not limited to paragraph openings. D-minim forms occur both internally and at continuation starts.
countercases: The many internal dain/daiin/daiiin forms already contradict an exceptionless d-only-at-physical-line-start rule.

The report's exact other-a controls include ar at continuation starts. Thus an absolute requirement to prepend d to every a-initial written group is already contradicted under the scoped transcription contract.
Other a-initial groups strongly avoid entry too. The report expressly warns that its MINIM_SPECIFIC outcome name is not a demonstrated statistically distinctive minim mechanism.
specific_existing_entry_evidence.limits: Physical continuation is not independently identified syntactic continuation. The zero does not prove that aiin and daiin encode the same underlying word, nor that d is a silent entry stroke. RF lacks the paragraph flags required for the primary paragraph comparison. No reader pooling.

already_executed_closest_followup.contract: Fixed exact ain/aiin/aiiin tail plus the next two complete groups on the same physical line. For D continuation starts, search internal BARE and internal D counterparts, separately in the same source-marked paragraph and physical leaf. Definite gaps, exact spellings and reader separation remain compulsory.
already_executed_closest_followup.decision: NO_LOCAL_COUNTERPARTS: neither bare nor D partners were available under that contract. This is a comparison-capacity stop, not evidence against allomorphy or evidence for different meanings.
already_executed_closest_followup.retained_stop: The primary expressly forbids shortening the context or expanding the paragraph scope after this outcome, and selects no decoder or additional local predictor.

existing_unselected_variant.fixed_idea: Two opaque internal classes are retained: B_m writes B_m internally and D_m at physical entry; D_m always writes D_m. This permits internal D without an exception. It does not assert equality of the classes' meanings.
existing_unselected_variant.difference_from1150: Its exact right-two/right-three signatures may cross a physical line within the same paragraph.1150 explicitly records that this different contract was not executed there. The raw status must not be silently converted to an exact1150 failure.
existing_unselected_variant.why_not_selected: The card itself admits that a lexical-position rival can reproduce an observed counterpart, and exact neighboring strings alone need not identify the same underlying construction. The changed window does not by itself justify reopening the capacity stop.

wrapper_prior_chain.scope: Opaque wrapper identity transfers across strata; the claim ceiling explicitly excludes an identified prefix, sound, function or meaning. It is not a proof that initial d is mechanically expendable.
Host association and position interaction are retained. Its nonpositive host-position-increment gate failed; a context-free host class was insufficient.
Cross-host positional transfer and the small latent-class versions failed. An observed positional tendency cannot be promoted into a universal compact handwriting rule from these reports.
The positive entry-state result retains opaque compatibility cells and source-context probabilities. It is neither a deterministic d deletion rule nor a same-lexeme finding.

This is the exact later d-specific check: all318surfaces were excluded, and the line-start/post-DY selector failed fresh-surface transfer. d remained an exposed-panel coefficient rather than a reusable selector.
The retained reduced model contains s×LINE_START and q×PREV_DY, not a promoted d rule. Its success does not supersede320.

separated_component_evidence.observation: ZL3b f35v.12 G2–5 contains d / aiin / d / aiin as a recorded definite-boundary period-two hit. This is existing transcription evidence for the separated arrangement, not a newly opened image or an all-reader case.
separated_component_evidence.limit: The report explicitly warns that single-letter-group patterns must not automatically be called multiword phrases. A written gap does not establish d as an autonomous semantic word, nor the identity of separated d+aiin with every fused daiin.

separated_component_evidence.observation: The existing complete-page report preserves RF1b's d aiin split in f25v.5. It is alternate grouping of the same manuscript material, not an independent example of a scribe switching between forms.

separated_component_evidence.scope: The exact joined/split matched held-folio design had no eligible pairs and never scored a predictor. That capacity stop does not prove spacing meaningless and does not authorize a relaxed repetition of the same test.

meaning_and_generalization_limits.scope: The universal paragraph-local overt-host rule failed for the full d/minim family. Exact aiin retained left-host capacity; daiin was sensitive to paragraph annotation. Capacity is not an identified dependency or meaning, and this was not a physical-entry allomorph test.
The old aiin/daiin apprentice card was explicitly an invented constructional reading from a small exposed sample. Its active/parameter glosses are historical guesses, not reusable lexical evidence.

It already mentions separated d aiin and fused daiin, but then assigns dose-like meanings. Those assignments are not adopted. Its rendering PASS and later completion cards do not prove a shared d meaning or literal identity.

The al/dal/ar/dar lattice was explicitly reviewed; its semantic remainder did not transfer as a general productive rule. Whole-group separation and cross-location fusion do not establish an internal parse or freely export d/al/dal meanings. Historical provisional glosses remain unused.

single_remaining_discriminator: The relevant unresolved distinction is whether an independently warranted same underlying construction is written with an added d specifically because the physical break moved, rather than the break being placed around a distinct whole form or a dependent expression. The four pair shapes, line-entry zeros and reader spacing disagreements do not identify such a construction.1150 already sought the nearest exact local written counterparts and found no capacity. No newly available independently bound comparison was established by this review.
disposition: Retain the existing formal entry and spacing positives with their exact scopes. Keep882raw and1150parked; do not recast either as a semantic result. No new card, corpus count, image task or handwriting rule is selected from this prior review.
